name: Oh no! I have a cosplay fanclub
source:
You’ve been doing the same thing for years. Working at the office, avoiding all contact and doom scrolling social media looking at pretty girls. You start cosplaying to be someone you’re not, someone you like. Then the unexpected happens, a big cosplayer shares your post and it is being spread like wildfire. You’ve gone viral and now you’ve accidentally gained a whole funclub dedicated to desiring you. 

A story with cosplay, about popularity, romance and comedy.

[Edited from [url=https://jennymhulla.itch.io/oh-no-i-have-a-cosplay-fanclub]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
多年来你一直在做同样的事情。在办公室工作，避免所有接触，并在社交媒体上浏览漂亮女孩。你开始角色扮演，成为一个你不是的人，一个你喜欢的人。然后意想不到的事情发生了，一个大角色扮演者分享了你的帖子，并且它像野火一样传播开来。你已经像病毒一样走红，现在你意外地获得了一个专门对你感兴趣的有趣俱乐部。

一个关于cosplay的故事，关于流行、浪漫和喜剧。

[编辑自[url=https://jennymhulla.itch.io/oh-no-i-have-a-cosplay-fanclub]itch.io[/url]]
